lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 8-10 visible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical spot columns to form a rectilinear grid across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature running through the upper-mid flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light above to shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A trailing high-luminance linear structure, consistent with a parasitic remora or organic attachment, is visible at the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast spot pattern distributed across the entire dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
